records.question: 2001 年 2 月的门店退货率是多少？口径：门店退货率（%）= 期间内售出的门店销售行所对应的退货金额（sr_return_amt）之和 ÷ 这些销售行的净支付额（ss_net_paid）之和 × 100；按销售日期归属期间，退货按小票号和商品与销售行对应，每笔退货只计一次。保留两位小数。

run.sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_item_sk, ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN 398 AND 425
),
ret AS (
  SELECT SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt
  FROM sales s
  JOIN store_returns r
    ON r.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
   AND r.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
)
SELECT
  ret.return_amt,
  (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM sales) AS net_paid,
  ROUND(ret.return_amt / (SELECT SUM(ss_net_paid) FROM sales) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM ret;
